code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row}:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        if (all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1+1)) and
            all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1+1))):
            fill = 2 if (r1-r0-1) % 2 == 0 and (c1-c0-1) % 2 == 0 else 7
            for r in range(r0+1, r1):
                for c in range(c0+1, c1):
                    out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
